Refund_not_showing_up: Customer has already requested or been promised a refund from a merchant and it has not yet appeared in their account, asking where it is or when it will arrive.
activate_my_card: Questions about how to activate or switch on a newly received card, or problems getting the activation to work.
age_limit: Questions about minimum age requirements for holding an account or opening one for a child.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Questions about topping up or adding money using Apple Pay, Google Pay, or an Apple Watch.
atm_support: Questions about which ATMs or cash machines accept the card and where cash can be withdrawn.
automatic_top_up: Questions about setting up, locating, or limits on the automatic/recurring top-up feature.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money transferred in from another bank account has not appeared in the balance, or the balance is unchanged after an incoming transfer.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cash or cheque deposit has not yet shown up in the account balance.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Transfers are blocked or error out because the beneficiary/payee is not allowed, and the customer asks why.
cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel, reverse, or correct a transfer or payment they have already sent, often due to an error.
card_about_to_expire: Customer's card is expiring or has expired and they want to know how to obtain a renewal/replacement, including cost, speed, or availability abroad.
card_acceptance: Questions about which shops, merchants, or businesses accept the card and whether there are places it cannot be used.
card_arrival: An ordered card has not yet arrived after waiting, and the customer asks whether it is still coming, if it is lost, or how to track it.
card_delivery_estimate: Questions about how long card delivery takes, the expected arrival date, or whether delivery can be expedited, before the card is considered late.
card_linking: Questions about adding or re-adding an existing card (including a lost card that was found) to the app so it shows up there.
card_not_working: The physical card has generally stopped working, is broken, or cannot be used, without a specific stated cause such as contactless, decline reason, or virtual card.
card_payment_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee or transaction charge for making a payment with their card and questions why.
card_payment_not_recognised: An unfamiliar or unremembered card payment/merchant charge appears on the statement or app.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card purchase appears incorrect or worse than expected.
card_swallowed: The ATM retained, trapped, or swallowed the card and the customer asks how to get it back.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Customer was charged a fee for withdrawing cash from an ATM and asks why or whether such fees exist.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears on the account that the customer did not make, possibly indicating card cloning or theft.
change_pin: Questions about how, where, or whether the customer can change their card PIN to a new number.
compromised_card: Customer suspects fraud, hacking, or someone else using their card or account and wants it stopped.
contactless_not_working: Contactless payments specifically are failing, and related troubleshooting such as reinstalling the app.
country_support: Questions about which countries the service or card is available in or usable in, and eligibility based on where the customer lives.
declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or refused at a shop or terminal and the customer wants to know why.
declined_cash_withdrawal: An attempt to withdraw cash at an ATM was declined or refused.
declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected with a decline message and the customer asks why.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: An unrecognised or suspicious direct debit appears in the account statement.
disposable_card_limits: Questions about restrictions, usage counts, or transaction limits on disposable/virtual cards.
edit_personal_details: Customer wants to update personal information such as name, address, or other profile details.
exchange_charge: Questions about fees or hidden charges for exchanging one currency into another.
exchange_rate: Questions about what exchange rate is offered, how it is calculated, or its current value, without a fee or transaction complaint.
exchange_via_app: Questions about whether and how to convert money between currencies within the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: Customer queries a small unexplained extra charge (typically £1/$1) appearing on the statement.
failed_transfer: A transfer repeatedly fails or cannot be completed, and the customer asks why or suspects a system problem.
fiat_currency_support: Questions about which and how many traditional currencies the account can hold money in.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Questions about obtaining disposable virtual cards or what they are used for and why.
get_physical_card: Questions about the PIN for a physical card, including where to find it, when it arrives by post, or what to do without one.
getting_spare_card: Requests for extra, additional, or second physical cards, including whether extras cost anything.
getting_virtual_card: Requests for how to order, sign up for, or obtain a (non-disposable) virtual card, including it not having arrived.
lost_or_stolen_card: Customer reports a card lost or stolen and wants it frozen, replaced, or checked for activity.
lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer reports their phone or bag was lost or stolen and needs to protect app access.
order_physical_card: Questions about how to order a physical card for the first time, its cost, and where it can be delivered.
passcode_forgotten: Customer has forgotten or cannot use their app passcode or password and cannot log in.
pending_card_payment: A card payment is showing as pending and the customer asks what that means or how long it takes to clear.
pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal is showing as pending in the account.
pending_top_up: A top-up is showing as pending or not yet credited, and the customer asks how long it takes.
pending_transfer: A transfer the customer made is showing as pending and they ask how long it takes to complete.
pin_blocked: The PIN has been blocked or the account locked after too many incorrect PIN attempts, and the customer needs it unblocked or reset.
receiving_money: Questions about how to receive incoming money such as salary or payments from friends into the account.
request_refund: Customer asks how to request or obtain a refund for a purchase, or about refund policy and timing, before any refund is pending.
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment went out and was then returned or reversed back into the account, and the customer wants to know why.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Questions about which card types (e.g. American Express) and which currencies can be used to add money to the account.
terminate_account: Customer wants to close, delete, or deactivate their account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Questions about fees for topping up the account via bank or SEPA transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge: Questions about fees for topping up the account using a card, including international or US cards.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Questions about whether and how to top up or deposit using cash or a cheque.
top_up_failed: A top-up attempt failed, was rejected, or would not go through at all.
top_up_limits: Questions about maximum amounts or number of top-ups allowed and raising those limits.
top_up_reverted: A top-up that initially appeared has been cancelled or reverted and the money has disappeared.
topping_up_by_card: Topping up using a card where the money left the card but is not visible in the account, or general questions about card top-ups.
transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction appears twice or multiple times and the customer wants the duplicate charge removed.
transfer_fee_charged: Customer was charged a fee for making a transfer and questions or disputes it.
transfer_into_account: Questions about how to add money to the account via bank transfer from another bank, including linking the bank.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Money sent to another person has not yet arrived in the recipient's account.
transfer_timing: Questions about how long an incoming transfer to the customer's own account will take to arrive.
unable_to_verify_identity: Customer is trying to verify their identity but it is failing or being rejected, and asks why or for help.
verify_my_identity: Customer asks how to complete identity verification and what documents or information are required.
verify_source_of_funds: Questions about checking, tracing, or proving where the money in the account came from.
verify_top_up: Questions about how to verify a top-up card, including the verification code.
virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable virtual card is being rejected or not working for a transaction.
visa_or_mastercard: Questions or preferences about whether the card is a Visa or Mastercard and requests to switch between them.
why_verify_identity: Customer questions the reason for identity checks or objects to providing personal identification information.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM dispensed less or a different amount of cash than requested or than shown in the app.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: The exchange rate applied to a cash withdrawal, typically abroad, appears wrong and the customer feels overcharged.
